title: Infuse masterclass
description: This pack is made for servers that use the infuse plugin. I made this pack to help anybody new to smps or minecraft in general.
body:
Perfect for all gamemodes. look up how to use mods there is to many to make instructions. 

this pack has freecam (modded spectator mode),

map mods for navigation,

and a custom command keybind mod so u can bind your infuse powers for pvp.

this pack has many other quality of life mods that are not blacklisted on most servers.
